newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT - BPI rates SM Prime a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - BPI rates SM Prime a buy.

text.p: BPI Capital Corp said on Friday it recommended a buy on shopping mall developer SM Prime Holdings due to the several mall projects it had in the pipeline.
Analyst Bernadette Tamayo said the company is scheduled to complete two malls by March next year, adding 27 percent to its mall space.
She added that two new malls are expected to be built every year in the next five years.
"This expansion programme should see lease income grow by 50 percent in the next three years," Tamayo said in her research paper.
She added the stock, which was at 6.20 pesos by Friday's mid-morning trade, was still trading at a discount to its net assets value of seven pesos.
